messages:
Incident Bot: observability.alerts triggered 9: Datadog ingestion delays impacting metric and trace pipelines for inference-prod. Some composite alerts suppressed due to missing rollups. Ticket: DD-789999. See Datadog status.

Alex: oncall here. Acked. Are any customers paged already or seeing errors? Need quick impact assessment.

Sam: seeing ~20-40m ingestion backlog for metrics and ~10-30m delay for traces depending on region. Dashboards for high-cardinality metrics show holes. Logs are arriving but with increased latency.

Maria: Datadog status confirms ingestion delays in us-east and eu-west. Hosts still reporting heartbeats; agent check-in ok. Looks like aggregation pipelines are the main issue.

Jordan: which of our alerts are Datadog-only? We should confirm fallback readiness.

Sam: app-level metrics and synthetic checks go straight to Datadog. We do have Prometheus exporters for infra and a minimal set of app counters (request_errors_total, request_latency_seconds_bucket) on a few edge nodes.

Alex: plan:
- Flip critical alerts (ERR_SERVE_01, LAT_99P_5M, MODEL_DEGRADED) to Alertmanager/Grafana.
- Turn off suppression rules that hide raw host alerts.
- Notify CS + status page with initial blurb.

Sam: updating alert-router now. Pushing route to send critical IDs to alertmanager.

Sam: command used:
```
curl -X POST "https://internal-config.redwood/api/alertrouter" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -d '{"alert_ids":["ERR_SERVE_01","LAT_99P_5M","MODEL_DEGRADED"],"receiver":"alertmanager"}'
```
Sam: response: {"updated":3,"ok":true}

Ops Bot: Reminder: scheduled handoff Alex -> Jordan 00:30 UTC. Jordan will be primary after that.

Jordan: I'll take over at handoff. Sam, confirm Alertmanager is receiving a test alert.

Sam: sent a test ERR_SERVE_01 event; Alertmanager shows it firing and grouped. Increased priority to P1 for the rerouted alerts.

Priya: CS here. Drafting customer message: "We are seeing observability degradation due to Datadog ingestion delays which may cause delayed dashboards and alerts. We rerouted critical monitoring and are investigating with Datadog. No evidence of data loss. Updates every 15 minutes." Add link to our status page?

Alex: include Datadog ETA if they provided one and link to internal ticket. Also mention fallback to request logs for verification.

Maria: opened support ticket with Datadog: DD-789999. They acknowledged a backlog and estimate ~2h to fully clear ingestion (subject to change). Internal ticket created with their support rep.

Jordan: mitigation checklist while Datadog is degraded:
- Keep critical alerts routed to Alertmanager
- Use Prometheus queries for host-level and exporter counters
- Verify request integrity via logs in S3/ELK pipeline
- Avoid routine config rollouts unless necessary

Sam: enabling extra agent debug on 6 edge hosts to see any agent-side retries. Restarting datadog-agent on selected nodes to force flush.

Sam: command snippet:
```
for host in edge-1 edge-2 edge-5; do ssh $host "sudo systemctl restart datadog-agent"; done
```

Incident Bot: update recorded at 1760904850  Datadog reports backlog decreasing but delays continue. Next auto-update in 15m.

Priya: posting to external status and notifying key customers. CS preparing FAQs: Is my data safe? Are alerts missed? When will dashboards return?

Support: queued common responses. If a customer reports missed alerts, we should ask for request-id and check S3 logs for the timeframe.

Maria: sharing Prometheus query for quick checks:
```
curl -s "http://prometheus.internal/api/v1/query?query=sum(rate(request_errors_total[5m]))"
```

Sam: backlog timer is trending down: was ~32m, now ~16m. I'll keep watching the ingestion queue and post periodic updates.

Jordan: keeping this thread as the source of truth. If Datadog clears and we observe stable alerts for 30m, we'll close incident and start a postmortem focusing on:
- Better automatic failover for alerting
- Clarify suppression rules that hid critical host alerts
- Document playbook for Datadog ingestion incidents

Alex: postmortem owners assigned: Sam (alerting/fallback) and Maria (vendor escalation and diagnostics). I'll publish the postmortem template once incident is resolved.

Incident Bot: last activity logged at 1760908572  continuing monitoring.
